text:
maria: Scheduling TidalWorks Dedicated switchover for Tue 2026-03-31 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need approvals + rollback pin.
chris: Customer maintenance window is 02:00-04:00 UTC. Ops prefer start at 02:30 to avoid DB backup overlap. Can we shift?
sre-lead: 02:00 works for SRE. We'll staff primary oncall. If we need to push to 02:30 it's ok but prefer 02:00 for quieter traffic.
maria: leaning 02:00. TidalWorks asked for 30m notice — account-exec has been looped in.
account-exec: Notified customer this morning. They'll confirm final 24h before. 30m notice OK.
eng-release: Approving change window. Please add runbook link and rollback conditions.
ops: Runbook added: https://go/repo/tidalworks/runbook.md
ops: runbook excerpt:
```bash
# healthcheck thresholds
CHECK=http://tidalworks-prod/health
MAX_5xx=0.02
ROLLBACK_CMD=deploy rollback --customer tidalworks --to v2.1.3
```
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by @maria for tidalworks-prod
- target: dedicated
- version: v2.2.0
- window: 2026-03-31T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-31T03:00:00Z
- canary: 10% for 10m
maria: Please pin fallback to v2.1.3 in case of issues.
sre-lead: Agreed. Rollback plan: auto rollback if 5xx > 2% over 5m or error rate spike after canary. Manual rollback threshold: any data loss or OOM in logs.
eng-release: Release notes: v2.2.0 includes quantization kernel tweaks and model routing fallback. No DB migrations.
maria: Running preflight checklist 02:45 UTC 03/31 and will post logs.
deploy-bot: preflight result: OK
- disk: OK
- gpus: 8/8 healthy
- infra-latency: 48ms P50
chris: Approved from customer side (:thumbsup:)
eng-release: Official approval: :white_check_mark: go for deployment at 02:00 UTC
sre-lead: Oncall SRE: @alex will be primary, @sam secondary. Escalation pager set.
maria: Final note: command we will run:
```bash
deploy --env dedicated --customer tidalworks --version v2.2.0 --canary 10% --pin-fallback v2.1.3
```
deploy-bot: Deployment started 2026-03-31T02:00:12Z
maria: Watching logs. If anything odd, I'll shout and abort.
sre-lead: If rollback occurs, we will notify and record in incident channel.
eng-release: Marking thread approved, archiving post-deploy notes here.
account-exec: Customer asked for post-deploy health email; I'll send once canary OK.
maria: 02:12 canary looks green. Proceed to 100% over 8m.
deploy-bot: Canary passed. Promoting to 100%.
maria: Promotion complete. Closing window. Thanks everyone! :tada:
